$comment: Shortcuts for onboarding screen 3, listed under the free-text field. PDR 14 leaves the final list open; this is a draft. Every one is phrased as something a person is going through or asking themselves - never as a diagnosis. The mockups showed 'Superar la depresión' and 'Reducir ansiedad', which PDR 1.1 explicitly forbids: the copy must never make the user diagnose themselves. topic_hints feed $inferred_topics in the hard filter; they are hints for retrieval, not labels applied to the person.
helper_es: Escribilo con tus palabras. Si no sabés por dónde empezar, tocá alguna de estas.
